name: Scenic Beauty of Geosites in Southeastern Spain (rating)
description:
Faithful replication of Tessema, G. A., Poesen, J., Verstraeten, G., Van Rompaey, A., & van der Borg, J. (2021). The scenic beauty of geosites and its relation to their scientific value and geoscience knowledge of tourists: a case study from southeastern Spain. Land 10:460. This is the paper's online photo questionnaire (Questionnaire S1), used by the two groups who did not visit the sites. Participants see 34 geosites in Almería, Murcia and Granada one at a time, in the paper's fixed order (the order of the field visit). Each geosite is shown with its 2–3 photos (74 in total: an overview first, then detail), rated for scenic beauty on a five-point scale (1 = not at all interesting, 2 = slightly, 3 = moderately, 4 = very, 5 = extremely interesting), with an optional box for the features that are very interesting. The paper's ten background questions follow: gender, age, education level, educational background, whether it is related to earth science, geoscience courses taken, preferred types of tourist attraction, country of residence, continents visited and whether the respondent has visited the geosites (the paper excluded those who had). Analysis as in the paper: compare mean scenic beauty per geosite between respondents with and without a geoscience background (one-way ANOVA) and correlate it with the geosites' scientific value (Pearson). Original result: 104 respondents without and 43 with a geoscience background rated the photos, and 29 geoscience students and staff rated the sites on a field visit; scenic beauty correlated positively with scientific value, more strongly for respondents with geoscience knowledge; a geoscience background went with higher scenic beauty ratings, and geosites with viewpoints scored higher.

Differences from the original study: (1) the original was an online form sent by email; here the same questions run on SP-Survey. (2) A third gender option "Other / prefer not to say" was added. (3) The "Other, please specify" text field for education level is reduced to a single "Other" option.

Photographs: Questionnaire S1 of the paper (CC BY 4.0), with each photo's credit shown under it as in the paper: G. Tessema, J. Poesen, Google Earth Images, S. Hall, iaguas.es, Soleá, micROCKScopica and A. Strekeisen. Used with credit; the template is removed if the authors or photographers object.
